scope: Independent official-site/PDF and official-tourism discovery. No forms submitted, messages sent, bookings, or banned aggregator pages opened.
verdict: Promising but unqualified: the published sources do not establish all locked requirements for 185 guests.

discovery_result: No public wedding-specific menu/contract/room plan found through targeted official-domain and official-tourism searches. This establishes a research gap, not proof that such documents do not exist.
recommended_next_step: Use the direct sales email to request a scaled 185-guest floor plan, heated indoor ceremony/holding arrangement, separate cocktail space, vendor/candle/end-time rules and itemized 2027 wedding proposal. Ask whether a simple BBQ/buffet and beer/wine format can use the club culinary team; do not assume golf-outing rates apply.

additional_checks.needed: Check November 13 first, then November 6, November 20 and November 12, 2027, in that order. Request Saturday and Friday pricing, booking window, hold terms, deposit, payment schedule and cancellation/date-change policy.

Written room/package price and minimum, service charge and taxes, ceremony/flip charge, staffing and bar hours, setup/breakdown, security, required rentals and fees. Confirm whether parking is free and changing rooms are available early enough for getting ready.
Clarify the included day-of coordinator responsibilities and hours. Do not remove the separate coordinator budget unless the couple confirms this service covers their needs.
Keep the reserve untouched. A calculated package ceiling is not a quote or confirmed fit. Keep budget figures private in vendor messages.

Confirm We Love Photography may work at the venue, plus the selected videographer. The original must-have names outside DJ/florist/cake; honoring the booked photographer is an additional concrete planning check.
